messages:
maria: Quick debrief from today's scaling debrief — I extracted the postmortem tasks into a compact action log so we can close loop on owners/timelines. https://redwood.internal/pm/gpu-scaling-debrief (short summary below)

maria: TL;DR: recurrent midday degradation -> scheduler backpressure + quota misrouting. Root fixes are staged but we need tracked owners for: quota gating, scheduler config hardening, short-term headroom guard, and a weekly regression check.

aj: Thanks for pulling this together. can we list concrete owners + due dates in this thread? want to sync with capacity sprint. :white_check_mark:

sanjay: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: land the conservative token-bucket change, add a dry-run flag for 48h, then promote. Owner: sanjay. Due: 2026-04-02. Notes: config snippet below to test on canary:

```
# scheduler tuning (canary)
max_inflight_per_node: 14
token_bucket_rate: 0.9  # throttle slow api bursts
prefetch_window_ms: 50
```

elaine: I'll own quota gating + alerting. Owner: elaine. Due: 2026-03-31. Action: add a soft-stop at 92% GPU quota, escalate to paging if >95% for 5m. Also add a metric for per-tenant headroom drift.

thor: I'll pair with elaine on the alert runbook. thor -> add playbook steps for graceful fallback to low-cost model variants and region failover. Due: 2026-04-05.

maria: Short-term headroom guard: add a temporary global reserve of 8 GPUs to be held for burst traffic while we stabilize autoscale. Owner: maria + infra. Due: 2026-03-29. Implementation note: controlled by rollout flag `headroom.reserve.gpus=8` in ops config.

aj: Who will own the retrospective follow-ups list and ensure these land in the sprint board? we need a single tracker.

maria: I'll own the tracker for the next 2 weeks; then hand off to ops rotations. I'll create tasks in JIRA and link here.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary change for scheduler tuning (sanjay) on 2026-03-28 22:00 UTC. Please ack.

sanjay: acked. I'll annotate the dry-run with a bump test and a perf trace hook.

elaine: Quick question on quotas — do we enforce soft-stop per-customer or per-queue? prefer per-queue to protect shared batch jobs.

maria: Per-queue by default; add per-tenant override for enterprise customers. We'll document in the runbook.

thor: Will add a short troubleshooting checklist to the runbook: how to identify quota misrouting, how to validate KV cache warmup, and how to restart scheduler replicas without dropping in-flight KV.

aj: Can we add a recurring weekly test (synthetic traffic) to detect the pattern earlier? something small that triggers our alert path.

sanjay: I'll attach a lightweight load script (10 concurrent short requests over 2m) to the canary job. If headroom falls below threshold during script, trigger paging.

maria: Summary of owners/dates to close on before Friday:
- scheduler tuning (sanjay) — 2026-04-02
- quota gating + alerting (elaine) — 2026-03-31
- headroom reserve rollout (maria + infra) — 2026-03-29
- runbook + fallback steps (thor) — 2026-04-05
- recurring synthetic test (sanjay + aj) — 2026-03-30

elaine: I'll open the PR for alerts today and ping this thread when it's live.

maria: Thanks all. please react with :white_check_mark: when you've added the JIRA task and set the due date. we'll follow up in the next oncall handoff.

aj: added tasks and set due dates. leaving a note in capacity-sprint board. :thumbsup:

sanjay: PR for scheduler dry-run created: https://git.internal/r/scheduler/pulls/82 — adding perf hooks.

thor: Runbook PR up: https://git.internal/r/docs/pulls/47 — added fallback steps and troubleshooting checklist.

ops-bot: Task tracker updated: 5 open action items, next check-in scheduled 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC.

maria: closing loop for today. we'll reopen if the canary shows regressions. thanks everyone. :heart:
